You may edit Markdown documentation files when the user explicitly asks you to update or refine proposal docs, plans, ADRs, or other `.md` files that are part of the discussion.

## Challenge assumptions

Review a proposed plan or decision for missing evidence, boundary failures, unsafe concurrency, hidden scope reduction, and plausible counterexamples. Keep the review read-only unless the user explicitly asks for edits to a proposal or plan. Give actionable findings and distinguish observed facts from inference.
